title: verbascum collinum
intro: Verbascum collinum, commonly known as Collinsonia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Scrophulariaceae family. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in alleviating symptoms of colds, coughs, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum collinum include its expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which may help in relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents present in Verbascum collinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
